Lessons.Title: Probability
ExplanationParagraphs: Probability assigns values between0 and1 to outcomes and sums to1 across an exhaustive partition.
Union: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B), simpler sum if disjoint.
For independent events P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B); drawing without replacement is generally dependent.
Counting combinations and permutations can enumerate sample spaces.
Independent Cool-down: calculate a representative source-family example and check the result with the definition.
